title: First variation of an integer multiplicity current whose support is locally a C¹ submanifold with constant density
statement: For all P, n, k ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), every integer multiplicity triple R = (S, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep U n representing T, every M ⊆ ℝ^P, p ∈ ℝ^P and ρ ∈ ℝ with B_ρ(p) ⊆ U: if k ≥ 1, M is an embedded C¹ n-dimensional submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 n M), spt T ∩ B_ρ(p) = M ∩ B_ρ(p) and Θⁿ(μ_T, y) = k (HasMassDensity T y k) for every y ∈ spt T ∩ B_ρ(p), then for every C¹ vector field X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with compact support and tsupport X ⊆ B_ρ(p), the first variation of the varifold of R is R.firstVariation X = k·∫_{M ∩ B_ρ(p)} tr(P_x ∘ DX(x)) dH^n(x), where P_x is the orthogonal projection onto span(tangentSpace M x) and H^n := μHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (p : Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ball p ρ ⊆ U → 1 ≤ k → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 n M → T.support ∩ ball p ρ = M ∩ ball p ρ → (∀ y ∈ T.support, y ∈ ball p ρ → HasMassDensity T y k) → ∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ ball p ρ → R.firstVariation X = (k : ℝ) * ∫ x in M ∩ ball p ρ, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ X x).toLinearMap) ∂μHE[n]
